decision: Whether the constitution's twelve mandated files accumulate across domains under their mandated names, or are re-created per domain with domain prefixes
options: (a) one accumulating file per mandated name at the C-3 home [taken]; (b) one per domain, domain-prefixed
why_owner: Standing product decision about the shape of the evidence base; it does not block research.
notes: Domain E created HYPOTHESIS-ELIGIBILITY.csv and CROSS-DOMAIN-BRIDGES.csv in 03-REGISTERS/, and ARCHIVE-AND-POWER-AUDIT.csv, BIAS-FAILURE-LOG.csv, REAUDIT-QUEUE.csv and INTERNAL-CONTRADICTIONS.csv in 04-AUDITS/, with §9's mandated columns. Domain-specific measurement registers keep domain-prefixed names. Reasoning: reconciliation C-3's own principle, one source of truth and not two.

decision: Whether measurements and interpretations are separated into different register files as standing practice
options: (a) separate files [taken for domain E, at the task's instruction]; (b) one register with a type column
why_owner: Standing method decision. Recorded rather than escalated.
notes: domain-e-measurements.csv holds only counts over named files with locators; domain-e-interpretations.csv holds what they mean, each row naming the measurements it rests on and its own falsifier. The benefit is that an interpretation cannot inherit a measurement's VERIFIED status by sharing a table with it. Recommend making it standing for all domains.

decision: Whether the git proxy's anonymous lane is the standing general retrieval channel when HTTP egress is narrow
options: (a) yes, with WebSearch confined to discovery [taken]; (b) treat narrow egress as a full stop
blocks: Nothing. Domain E would have produced no measurements under (b).
notes: SRC-042. The lane serves arbitrary public repositories even where api.github.com refuses them under session repository scoping. Discovery is done with WebSearch, which stays discovery-only per SRC-011; the candidate is then retrieved through the lane so a real retrieval event exists and a commit SHA pins it. Recorded so later units do not repeat the probing and do not quietly drop the discovery/retrieval separation.
